piece.caption: How to extract clean order sheets from messy WhatsApp messages using Gemini 4 Hydrogen. When distributors receive WhatsApp orders full of spelling mistakes and vague item names, retyping them into ERP software wastes hours. Google's new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model is designed to handle multi-part questions, hard typos, and structured table creation. You can paste raw client messages into the Gemini app or AI Studio to generate formatted tables instantly. Always verify item quantities before creating final GST invoices. Comment ORDER for the complete guide.

piece.dm_text: Here is how to extract messy WhatsApp orders using Gemini 4 Hydrogen: 1. Open the Google Gemini app or Google AI Studio. 2. Copy the client's messy WhatsApp text containing typos. 3. Prompt Gemini: 'Extract these items into a structured table with Columns: Item Name, Specifications, Quantity'. 4. Gemini 4 Hydrogen uses multi-part reasoning to handle typos and format the table. 5. Double check item quantities against original notes before generating final GST invoices.

Google’s Robby Stein says Gemini 4 Hydrogen is ‘the biggest model upgrade to Search yet.’﻿
Stevie Bonifield Nov 12, 2026, 9:55 PM UTC Link
Stevie Bonifield is a news writer covering all things consumer tech. Stevie started out at Laptop Mag writing news and reviews on hardware, gaming, and AI. Google says its new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model can give more helpful answers to complex questions, including “questions with multiple parts, hard-to-understand typos, or highly specific requests.” The new model can break down your questions and address each part in its responses. It’s available starting today in search, the Gemini app, all tiers of Google AI Studio, the Gemini API, Gemini for business, and in Google Antigravity for Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers. Robby Stein, VP of product at Google Search, says it’s “now the new default model in AI Mode & being used for your hardest questions in AI Overviews.”
Google says Gemini 4 Hydrogen also gives users a wider range of links in its responses by “conducting simultaneous queries across all the relevant subtopics.” Its responses have more visuals, too, like images, comparison tables, graphs, and maps. One of Stein’s examples shows the AI generating an interactive animated driving simulation in response to a user’s question about how phones locate which lane of a highway a car is on in areas without cell service. Google says the new model also has improved language understanding “across all supported AI Mode languages.”
Users have more thinking level options with Gemini 4 Hydrogen, as well, including low, medium, high, and a new “xhigh” mode. According to Google, the new model “delivers significant leaps in both speed and intelligence” compared to Gemini Flash 3.8 , and it “matches or outperforms some of the competing models in its class,” like Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Terra.

Today, Google Search is bringing cutting-edge intelligence to everyone with Gemini 4 Hydrogen . This is the biggest model upgrade to Search yet.
Hydrogen is now available globally in Google Search for all users, delivering more helpful, visual, and intuitive responses with improved model capabilities:
Better understanding of intent: Search can now handle even more nuanced and complicated questions, quickly understanding what you need. Just ask in your natural flow of thought — including questions with multiple parts, hard-to-understand typos, or highly specific requests. With deeper instruction following and tool calling, Search more precisely follows what you want and gives you relevant responses that address each part of your question.
Improved query fan-out and linking: Hydrogen’s advanced reasoning supercharges our query fan-out technique in Search, connecting you to a broader range of helpful links than before. By more thoroughly understanding your question and conducting simultaneous queries across all the relevant subtopics, Search helps you find sites you previously might not have discovered.
More visual responses: You get highly adaptive, visual, and easy-to-scan responses that are uniquely relevant to your needs — at the speed of Search. You’ll see more images, structured responses, comparison tables, and custom tools built for you.
Richer language understanding: No matter what language you ask in, you’ll now get more highly nuanced and helpful responses across all supported AI Mode languages.
